no model sticker, rear label, or settings screen showing model number in either photo

risks.risk: Exact model/panel tier unconfirmed (affects price heavily for 80+ inch LG sets, e.g. UHD vs QNED vs Mini-LED lines)
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rear label/model sticker or the TV's Settings > About screen
risks.if_unproven: priced as unidentified/base-tier 86-inch LG LED TV, not the specific named model

risks.risk: Actual screen size may differ from claimed 86 inches
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure across the diagonal, or a known-size object (person, door) beside the TV for scale
risks.if_unproven: priced at the smallest plausible size consistent with the photos, not 86 inches

risks.risk: Panel defects (dead pixels, uniformity issues, backlight bleed, physical scratches/dents) not visible in low-res staged photos
risks.proof: Close-up full-screen photos of solid white/black/grey fields taken in a dim room, plus a photo of the frame/bezel edges
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic/functional condition unknown, no premium for 'like new'

risks.risk: No remote control or accessories shown; may not be included
risks.proof: Photo of remote, power cable, and any original box
risks.if_unproven: priced as TV only, no accessories included

risks.risk: Photos may be stock/promotional images rather than the actual unit in seller's possession
risks.proof: A fresh photo of the TV with a handwritten note or today's newspaper/date visible, taken from an unedited angle
risks.if_unproven: priced with provenance risk, not treated as confirmed in-hand item

risks.risk: Functionality beyond the demo screen (HDMI inputs, Wi-Fi, speakers, tuner) not demonstrated
risks.proof: Short video clip switching inputs, playing sound, and showing live TV or an app loading
risks.if_unproven: priced as power-on/display only, not fully functional

proof_requests: Photo of the rear label/model sticker on the TV
Photo or video of Settings > About This TV screen showing model and serial number
Tape measure across the screen diagonal for size verification
Close-up photos of the full screen in solid white, black and grey to check for dead pixels/backlight bleed
Photo of remote control, power cable, and original box if available
A fresh, unedited photo with today's date/newspaper to confirm the seller currently has the unit
response.reason: The model number that would set the specific price tier is not visible in any photo and only comes from the seller's text, and the claimed 86-inch size has no scale reference to verify, so even a worst-case price cannot be fixed without these proofs.
